<pos> m.</pos>

<sense>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the shepherd’s assistant</italic>
<pgbrk id="pg666" />

<entry id="K01150">
<head-word>כַּרְטֵיס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (χάρτης) 
<italic>document</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. IX, end, 33
<sup>c</sup> כהן דמר אבד כַּרְטֵיסוֹ וכ' (not סן …) in accordance with the opinion of him who says, if one’s document (of indebtedness) is lost, write a duplicate for him. Ib. לבד מן כרטוסה קדמייא וכ' (read: כַּרְטֵיסָה or כַּרְטֵיסַיָּה 
<italic>pl.</italic>) irrespective of a previous document (or previous documents, against me) which may be in thy possession. Ib. [read:] אלא כי אורחא דבר נשא מימר אבד כַּרְטֵיסִי עבד חורן but is it a usual matter for a man to say (to his debtor), my document has been lost, write another for me?—V. קַרְטֵיס.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01151">
<head-word>כרי, </head-word>
<head-word>כָּרָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to round, heap, cave</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dig</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 11 כּוֹרֶה מנין how am I to know that he who digs a pit is responsible?—B. Kam. 51
<sup>a</sup> כורה אחר כורה one who digs after another one, i.e. who completes the pit to its legal size. Succ. 53
<sup>a</sup>; Macc. 11
<sup>a</sup> בשעה שכ' דוד וכ' when David dug for the foundations; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּרוּי, f. כְּרוּיָה 
<italic>hollowed out.</italic> Kel. III, 5, a. e., v. חִידּוּק a. בָּרָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sit in a circle</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְרָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to heap, pile</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 100 (ref. to כריתי, Gen. L, 5) הרבה ממון תַּכְרֶה עליה much money shalt thou pile up (give me) for it (the grave); (some ed. הכרה Jacob piled up in settling with Esau). Ib. הִכְרֵתִי (corr. הִכְרֵיתִי); v. כְּרִי; Pesik. R. s. 1 וכל ממון שהיה לו ה' וכ' (not מסר לו) and he (Jacob) piled up whatever money he had to place it before Esau &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to invite to a banquet</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> (with play on כרת) 
<italic>to excise, to destroy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 20
<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Sam. 142 (ref. to להברות, II Sam. III, 35, where Raba had before him a K’thib. להכרות) כתיב להכרות … בתחלה להַכְרוֹתוֹ וכ' it is written 
<italic>l’hakhroth</italic> (to entertain) and read 
<italic>l’habroth</italic> (v. בָּרָה): originally they came with the intention of destroying him (for the murder of Abner), and finally (when convinced of his innocence) they came to comfort him; [Yalk. Ms. to Sam. l. c., quoted in Rabb. D. S. Snh. l. c. note 9: כתיב לִבְרוֹת וקרינן להַבְרוֹת בתחלה לברות וכ' it is written 
<italic>libroth</italic> (
<italic>to pierce</italic>, cmp. Ez. XXIII, 47), and we read 
<italic>l’habroth</italic> &c.].</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K01152">
<head-word>כְּרֵי, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּרָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to dig, bore</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 33 יִכְרֵי ed. Berl. (oth. ed. יִכְרֶה). Targ. Ps. XL, 7; a. e.—B. Kam. 51
<sup>a</sup> אמרי ליה זיל כְּרֵי לן ואזל כְּרָא להו (some ed. כָּרָה hebr.) they said to him, go and dig for us, and he went and dug &c. Ib. 48
<sup>a</sup> כמאן דכַרְיֵיה דמי he is as responsible as if he had dug it. Succ. 53
<sup>b</sup> בְּרִינָן פורתא וכ' we bore only a little and there comes water; a. e.—*Taan. 24
<sup>a</sup> דהוה כָּרֵיא בהוצא that he was boring a hole in the fence (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note for Var. lect.).—[כרי 
<italic>to be narrow, distressed</italic>, part. כְּרִי, כַּרְיָא, 
<plural-form>pl. כְּרִין,</plural-form> v. כְּרַהּ]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01153">
<head-word>כְּרִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>heap, pile</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 31 (ref. to כריתי, Gen. L, 5, v. כָּרָה) נטל … ועשה אותו כ' he (Jacob) took all the money he possessed and made a pile of it; כ' של דינרין וכ' a pile of denars have I given to Esau. Tosef. Ter. III, 17. Ter. III, 5. Y. ib. I, 40
<sup>b</sup> bot. הבקיר כֶּרְיוֹ (not כריי) if a man renounced possession of his pile (store) of grain. Ib. IV, 42
<sup>d</sup> top לפטור את כִּירְיוֹ to discharge the duty of T’rumah for his entire store. Y. Gitt. VII, 48
<sup>c</sup> bot. תרם את כִּירְייוֹ if he gave T’rumah for his store; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּרָיִים</plural-form>. Y. Shek. III, end, 47
<sup>c</sup> אילו שני כ' וכ' if it were a case of two piles for which a person had discharged T’rumah &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01154">
<head-word>כַּרְיָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>כַּרְיָה</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>1) same.</definition>
<notes> ch. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. B. Mets. 105
<sup>a</sup> (in a tenant’s contract) ואוקים כ' וכ' and I will place the pile (of my crop) before thee.</definition>
<notes> Y. Maasr. I, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. (expl. משיתמרח) מן דו ישפר אפוי דכ' from the time he gives shape to the pile; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. כַּרְוָון, כֵּירָוָון, כֵּירָוָותָא</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Ex. VIII, 10, v. כּוֹרָא. Targ. II Chr. XXXI, 6, 7, sq. (h. text ערמות).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>digging, ditch; well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 8
<sup>a</sup> רמי כ' חדתא וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) put on orphans (heirs) the obligation of contributing towards a new ditch. Ib. (הכל) לכ' (ד)פתיא וכ' (Ms. F. בֵּירָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) even scholars must lend their services in digging a street-well; B. Mets. 108
<sup>a</sup> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60). Ib. 110
<sup>a</sup> וכרי כ' and must do what digging may be required (ditch, well), v. טַסְקָא. Ib. לכ' דנהרא for dredging the river (or channel).—*בית כ' 
<italic>House of Heaps</italic> (Ruins), a cacophemistic change of the name בֵּית גַּלְיָא, v. גַּלְיָא II. Ab. Zar. 46
<sup>a</sup>; Tem. 28
<sup>b</sup> (Var. כַּלְיָיא 
<italic>destruction</italic>).—[V., however, גַּדָּא a. גַּלָּא.]—Meg. 6
<sup>a</sup> בית כ' שלהן Ms. M. (ed. במיא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01155">

<entry id="K01156">
<head-word>כְּרִיָה, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּרִיָיה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כָּרָה) 
<italic>digging</italic>, esp. 
<italic>digging a pit</italic> through which an animal was injured (Ex. XXI, 33).</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 11; Tosef. B. Kam. VI, 13 נפל לפניו מקול כ' if the animal fell forward (into the pit) frightened by the sound of digging (within the pit), נפל לאחריו מקול הכ' if it tumbled backward &c. B. Kam. 49
<sup>b</sup> על עסקי כ' for the act of digging a pit (although not on his own soil). Ib. 50
<sup>a</sup> ה"א כ' הוא דבעי כיסוי I might have thought only when he dug the pit he is bound to cover it up; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01157">
<head-word>כְּרִיהָא, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּרִיחָא</head-word>

<senses>

<plural-form>Pl. כְּרִיהֵי, כְּרִיחֵי</plural-form>. Sabb. 21
<sup>a</sup> כל כ' דמערבא Ar. (ed. בריחי, corr. acc.) all sufferers of Palestine, v. קִיקָיוֹן. Ib. 145
<sup>b</sup> כריחי ed. Sonc. (ed. ב'; Ms. Rashi כְּרִיכֵי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01166">
<head-word>כְּרִיכָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כָּרךְ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>winding around</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vaëra 4 (ref. to Ber. V, 1) מה … כְּרִיכַת נחש למלכות what led the scholars to place the serpent winding itself around a person side by side with the (Roman) government?; Ex. R. s. 9.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>bundle, bunch, small sheaf</italic>, contrad. to אְלוּמָּה.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּרִיכוֹת</plural-form>. B. Mets. II, 1. Ib. 22
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—[Ib. 37
<sup>b</sup> כְּרֵיכוֹת, v. בֶּרֶךְ.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K01167">

<entry id="K01185">
<head-word>כָּרַךְ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. כָּרָה) 
<italic>to encircle, twine around, embrace, wrap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 39
<sup>a</sup> תכלת שכ' רובה a fringe the larger portion of which he twined together (v. תְּכֵלֶת). Ib. כדי שיִכְרוֹךְ וישנה וכ' enough to twine around three times. Yoma 38
<sup>a</sup> כְּרָכָהּ embraced it (clung to the bronze door). Sabb. 133
<sup>b</sup> וכָרְכֵהוּ בשיראין נאין Ms. M. (ed. וכוֹרְכוֹ) and twine handsome ribbons around it. Pes. 115
<sup>a</sup>; Zeb. 79
<sup>a</sup> היה כוֹרְכָן וכ' used to wrap them together (insert the Passover meat and the bitter herb between the Matsah). Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> כְּרָכוּהוּ בס"ת וכ' they wrapped him in a scroll of the Law and burned him. Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 20 כּוֹרְכִין תורה וכ' you may wrap the Pentateuch in covers intended for &c.; (Meg. 27
<sup>a</sup> גוללין); a. fr.—Pes. IV, 8; Tosef. ib. II (III), 19 כּוֹרְכִין את שמע they recited the confession of faith (Deut. VI, 4 sq.) in one כֶּרֶךְ, without the proper pauses (or without inserting ‘Blessed be the Name of His glorious kingdom &c.’ between verses 4 and 5), v. Pes. 56
<sup>a</sup>, a. Y. ib. IV, 31
<sup>b</sup>.—Part. pass. כָּרוּךְ, f. כְּרוּכָה; pl. כְּרוּכִים, כְּרוּכִין; כְּרוּכוֹת 
<italic>twined around, wrapped up</italic>; trnsf. (with אחר) 
<italic>clinging to, running after</italic>. Ber. V, 1 אפי' נחש כ' וכ' even if a serpent is wound around his heel, he must not interrupt his prayer, v. כְּרִיכָה. Kidd. 66
<sup>a</sup> הרי כ' ומונחת וכ' behold it (the Law) is wrapped up and lies in the corner, whoever wishes may study it. Gen. R. s. 78 בפנים כ' אני מהלך I shall walk with my face wrapped up (in humility).—Ḥull. 78
<sup>b</sup> (expl. Lev. XXII, 28) מי שׁבנו כ' אחריו that animal to whom the young clings (the mother). Sabb. 52
<sup>a</sup> כרוכין with the chain or halter twined around them, opp. נמשכין led by the chain &c. Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup> (קרנים) כרוכות horns the layers of which encircle one another. Ex. R. s. 33 היו כ' זה בזה their bodies were twisted around each other; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכְרַךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be twined around; to be wrapped up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ter. VII, 46
<sup>b</sup> bot. יִכָּרֵךְ המת בסדינו shall the dead be wrapped up in his sheet?, i.e. shall that man be abandoned to his fate?—Yoma 69
<sup>a</sup> שמא תִכָּרֵךְ וכ' lest one thread wind itself around (stick to) his body.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כֵּרֵךְ, כֵּי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; 
<italic>Hif.</italic> הִכְרִיךְ 
<italic>to wind around, wrap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. d’R. N. ch. III, beg. המַכְרִיךְ סמרטוטין וכ' he who ties a bandage over his eyes (pretending blindness) &c. Men. 39
<sup>a</sup> אפי' לא כי' בה וכ' even if he formed only one link by winding the twine around. Y. Ḥag. III, 79
<sup>a</sup> top וִיכָרְכֶינָּה בסיב ויטבילה let him wrap bast around it and so immerse it; ib. II, end, 78
<sup>c</sup> (corr. acc.). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 6 שהוא מְכָרֵךְ בו וכ' which one twines around the couch. Ib. מַכְרִיךְ.—Part. pass. מְכוֹרָךְ, 
<plural-form>pl. מְכוֹרָכִין</plural-form>. Lev. R. s. 35 הסייף … ניתנו מכ' וכ' (Sifré Deut. 40 כְּרוּכִים) the sword and the book have been handed from heaven wrapped up together; a. e.—[Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 1, v. כִּרְכֵּם.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> bot., sq. אתון כריכין (corr. acc.).—Trnsf. כְּרוֹךְ ותני combine the two versions into one. Sabb. 34
<sup>b</sup>. Men. 87
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense>

<sup>a</sup> top על נפש … וכ' מלאה when the appetite is satisfied and the stomach filled. Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Koh. XII, 6) זה הכ' ‘the pitcher is broken’, that means the stomach. Ib. לאחר שלשה … כְּרֵיסוֹ נבקעת וכ' three days after burial one’s stomach bursts open … saying (to the mouth), Take what thou hast put into me; Koh. R. to l. c.; Y. Yeb. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Gen. R. s. 100. Keth. 16
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. כְּרֵיסָהּ בין שיניה her belly extends to her teeth, i.e. she cannot deny her pregnancy. Koh. R. to VII, 8 [read:] היה מפעפע בכְרֵיסָהּ כאריסה וכ' burned in her stomach like the venom of &c.; [Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>d</sup> top ככריסה, v. חֲכִינָה]; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>the stomach of ruminants, maw</italic>. Ḥull. III, 1 הכ' הפנימית the inner stomach, expl. ib. 50
<sup>b</sup> כל הכ' כולו … ואיזהו כ' החיצון וכ' (masc. !) the whole maw is called the inner stomach, and the outer stomach is the flesh (muscle) which covers the largest portion of the stomach; ib. (another opinion) טפח בוושט סמון לכ' וכ', corrected; טפח בכ' סמוך לוושט one handbreadth of the stomach where it joins the gullet is called the inner stomach; [oth. defin., v. אִסְתּוֹמְכָא, דִּיבָא a. מֵילַת].—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּרֵיסוֹת</plural-form>. Succ. 21
<sup>b</sup> שכְּרֵיסוֹתֵיהֶן רחבות whose bellies are broad (projecting further than the rider’s body; Tosef. Par. III (II), 2 שכְּרֵיסָן רחבה).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup>. Koh. R. to XI, 9 כְּרֵיסֵיה דהאי גברא קומך בזעה this man’s (my) stomach is before thee, cut it open (I cannot pay for my meal); Pesik. Shub., p. 164

<sup>b</sup> bot. איכו ילדת לי חדא כ' אחריתי Oh that you would bear unto me one more issue of the womb!—Gen. R. s. 68 מני … בכ' דביתך (= h. בקרב ביתך) count twenty beams in the inner chamber of thy house; (Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55

<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. I, 3

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְרִיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to kneel; to subdue; to humiliate, sadden</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 65; Yalk. Gen. 114 אני מַכְרִיעַ את אוהבי I shall sadden my friend. Gen. R. s. 75, beg., v. כָּרַח. Ib. s. 67 מה אני מכריע וכ' (Yalk. ib. 116 מַעֲכִיר) why shall I sadden my father?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to put the knee of the balance down; to overbalance; to outweigh</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>b</sup> bot. הזכיות מַכְרִיעוֹת the good deeds overbalance (the sins). Ab. II, 8 מַכְרִיעַ את כלם outweighs them all. B. Bath. V, 11 חייב להַכְרִיעַ לו טפח (weighing a litra of meat or more) he must allow the scale (which contains the meat) to sink one handbreadth lower than the scale of weights, i.e. he must give overweight, opp. עיין to weigh exactly. Ib. 89
<sup>a</sup> שקול לי … והַכְרִיעָהּ weigh for me each litra for itself and give me the legal overweight on it; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. I, 3
<sup>c</sup> bot. הַכְרַע עליו כסף put money to it in the balance (bribe him). Gen. R. s. 80 כמה ממון ה' how much money he put in the balance (paid for it).—Trnsf. 
<italic>to cast the deciding vote, to decide</italic>. Tosef. Ḥull. VII, 1; Ḥull. 90
<sup>b</sup>; Pes. 83
<sup>b</sup> הדעת מַכְרַעַת reason decides, v. דַּעַת. Y. Keth. II, 26
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Yeb. X, 10
<sup>d</sup> bot. הדעת מכרעת בעידי מיתה (not לידי) reason decides in favor of trusting the witnesses testifying to the death of a person.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to keep the balance;</italic> trnsf. 
<italic>to harmonize two contrary opinions, to compromise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra introd. שני כתובים המכחישים … ויַכְרִיעַ ביניהם when two Biblical verses contradict each other, you must not draw any conclusions until a third verse is found which harmonizes them. Ib. end (ref. to Ex. 
<pgbrk id="pg673" />XIX, 20 a. Deut. IV, 36) הכ' השלישי a third passage (Ex. XX, 22) harmonizes (that the Lord lowered the heavens so as to make them rest on Mount Sinai); Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 9. Sifré Num. 58.—Kidd. 24
<sup>b</sup> המַכְרִיעִים לפני חכמים the harmonizers arguing before the scholars. Sabb. 39
<sup>b</sup> כל מקום … ואחד מכריע הלכה כדברי המכ' whenever you find two scholars differing and one compromising, the practice follows the opinion of the compromiser; a. fr.—V. הֶכְרַע, הַכְרָעָה.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K01280">
<head-word>כָּרַת</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. כָּרָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 16 ונקרא אשכול … לִכְרוֹת וכ' and he (Abraham’s ally) was named Eshkol (Cluster), on account of the cluster of grapes which the Israelites were destined to cut in his home.—Esp. 
<italic>to cut genitals, mutilate</italic>. Bekh. 33
<sup>b</sup> נותק אחר כּוֹרֵת, v. נָתַק.—Part. pass. כָּרוּת. Ib.; a. fr.—כְּ' שפכה one that is mutilated at his membrum, v. שָׁפַךְ. Tosef. Yeb. XI, 2. Yeb. VIII, 2; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to draw a circle, place outside</italic>, cmp. meanings of חרם, ברי,] 
<italic>to cut off, excommunicate</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="K01279">כָּרֵת</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bicc. II, beg. 64
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Snh. XI, 30
<sup>b</sup> צא … עונשין וכוֹרְתִים deduct twenty years up to which age the divine court neither punishes nor decrees excision.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to separate, divorce</italic>;
<italic> to make final</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 21
<sup>b</sup>; Succ. 24
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXIV, 3) ספר כּוֹרְתָהּ וכ' the delivery of the deed divorces her and nothing else does. Ib. דבר הכּוֹרֵת בינו לבינה something (a condition) which (if fulfilled) severs definitely the connection between him and her (e.g. a condition that she will drink no wine for the next thirty days, after the lapse of which time the letter of divorce takes its effect retroactively, opp. to a condition that she will abstain from wine all the rest of her life in which case the letter of divorce cannot take effect).—Part. pass. כָּרוּת 
<italic>definite</italic>. Y. Gitt. VII, 48
<sup>d</sup> כגט כ' הוא it is like a final divorce (taking effect immediately); Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16
<sup>c</sup> top כ' הוא. Y. Gitt. III, 44
<sup>d</sup> top; IX, 50
<sup>b</sup> bot. זה כ' לשמה ווה כ' לשמה (not זו) this letter was definitely made out for this woman, and so was the other for the other woman. Ib. III, beg. 44
<sup>c</sup> אלא שלא הי' לה כ' … ראשונה (strike out לה); a. fr.—3) 
<italic>to decide, make final</italic>. Ber. 4
<sup>a</sup>; Snh. 16
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to כְּרֵתִי as a symbolical name for the Urim and Tummim, or for the Sanhedrin) שכּוֹרְתִים את דבריהם they give definite and precise decisions; Midr. Till. to Ps. III כּוֹרְתֵי כריתות, v. כְּרִיתָה; a. e.—כ' בְּרִית (v. בְּרִית) 
<italic>to covenant, make a firm promise</italic>. Gen. R. s. 44 כָּרַתָּ ב' עם וכ' thou hast promised to Noah that thou wilt not destroy his descendants; Yalk. Gen. 76 כָּרַתָּה.—Part. pass. כָּרוּת, f. כְּרוּתָה. M. Kat. 18
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. ברית כ' לשפתים, v. בְּרִית. R. Hash. 17
<sup>b</sup> ב' כ' לי"ג מדזת וכ' there is a solemn insurance given that the invocation of the thirteen divine attributes (Ex. XXXIV, 6, sq.) will never be without effect (ref. to Ex. ib. 10).—Trnsf. ב' כ' 
<italic>it is a necessity, unavoidable</italic>. Nidd. 58
<sup>b</sup> ב' כ' לו שכל וכ' whoever crushes it cannot help smelling it.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכְרַת</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be cut, mutilated</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. VIII, 2 (expl. כרות שפכה, Deut. XXIII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> כל שנ' הגיד when the membrum is mutilated.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 75
<sup>b</sup> נִכְרְתוּ ביצים when the testicles are cut out; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>to be covenanted</italic>. Sot. 37
<sup>b</sup> שלא נִכְרְתוּ עליה וכ' upon which were not closed forty eight covenants; Tosef. ib. VIII, 11; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be cut off, destroyed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah I, 15
<sup>d</sup> bot. (ref. to Num. XV, 31) מלמד שהנפש נִכְרָתָה ועונה בה which intimates that (the idolater’s) soul is cut off (through premature death, כָּרֵת), while her guilt remains with her (unexpiated by death); Snh. 64
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to the emphasized expression הכרת תכ', Num. l. c.) הִכָּרֵת בעו"הז וכ' 
<italic>hiccareth</italic> refers to this world &c.; a. fr.—Verbal noun הִיכָּרֵת, v. כָּרֵת.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְרִית</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to destroy, exterminate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. R’eh 7 והַכְרִיתֵם and exterminate them. Ib. כשיַכְרִית וכ' when the Lord … shall have destroyed …, you will enter. Tosef. Snh. IV, 5 להַכְרִית זרעו וכ' to exterminate the seed of Amalek; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כֵּרֵת</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to doom to destruction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. 15
<sup>b</sup> שכבר כֵּרְתוֹ וכ' for David has doomed him &c. (ref. to Ps. XII, 4); Yalk. Lev. 559.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K01282">

<sense>
<definition> (= הִכָּרֵת, v.

<notes> Snh. 60
<sup>b</sup> זובח … כ' הוא is not slaughtering consecrated animals outside of the Temple punishable with extinction?, opp. קטלא death by execution. M. Kat. 28
<sup>a</sup> מת בחמשים שנה זו היא מיתת כ' if one dies at the age of fifty, that is death of divine visitation; Y. Bicc. II, beg. 64
<sup>c</sup> בהִיכָּרֵת; Treat. S’maḥ. III, 8 בהִכָּרֵת. Ib. 10 וכי מה מודיענו שמיתתם בהכרת what is there to indicate that they died by divine visitation?; Y. l. c. 64
<sup>d</sup> top שהוא בהיכרת.—M. Kat. l. c. נפקי לי מכ' I have escaped the punishment of 
<italic>kareth</italic> (being sixty years old). Ib. כ' דשני the 
<italic>kareth</italic> of years, premature death; כ' דיומי the 
<italic>k</italic>. of days, sudden death. Ḥull. 31
<sup>a</sup> עון כ' a transgression punishable with 
<italic>k.</italic>, opp. איסור מיתה. Macc. III, 15 (23
<sup>a</sup>) נפטרו מידי כְּרֵיתָן Ms. M. (ed. ידי כְּרִיתָתָם) are released from 
<italic>k</italic>. (which would otherwise await them). Ib. 13
<sup>b</sup> ולמה יצאת כ' באחותו why is the punishment of 
<italic>k</italic>. specifically mentioned with reference to incest with a sister (Lev. XX, 17, being included in Lev. XVIII, 29)?—Gen. R. s. 28 (ref. to כְּרֵתִים, Zeph. II, 5, v. Targ. a. l.) גוי שהוא ראוי כ' a nation deserving extermination; (Yalk. Zeph. 567 ראוי לִיכָּרֵת); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּרִיתוֹת</plural-form> (fr. כְּרִיתָה). Ker. I, 1 שלשים ושש כ' בתורה there are thirty six transgressions mentioned in the Torah as (eventually) punishable with 
<italic>kareth</italic>. Macc. III, 15, a. fr. חייבי כ' those on whose transgressions the penalty of 
<italic>k</italic>. is pronounced; a. fr.—K’rithoth, a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta, and Talmud Babli, of the Order of Kodashim.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>straight and exact</italic>), v. גְּבִי. Kidd. 80
<sup>b …</sup> מיחברי כ' וכ' ten persons combine to steal a beam and are not ashamed of one another; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּשׁוֹרִין, כְּשׁוֹרֵי</plural-form>. Targ. II Chr. XXXIV, 11. Targ. Cant. I, 17 כְּשׁוֹרוֹהִי (some ed. כָּשְׁרוֹהִי); a. e.—Sabb. 67

<sup>a</sup> גובי ועבדינהו כ' if one stole trunks and made them into joists (by trimming). Gitt. 67

<italic>lengthy slices of a radish</italic>. Sabb. 108
<sup>b</sup> במערבא מלחי כ' כ' Ms. M. (ed. כִּישְׁרֵי, Ar. כִּשְׁרֵי, Var. כִּישֵׁי; Alf. פישרי) in Palestine they salt them (on the Sabbath) each slice by itself (just as they are eaten).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>to make an object fit for levitical uncleanness</italic> (v. Lev. XI, 34; 38). Ḥull. 35
<sup>b</sup> וכי הדם מַכְשִׁיר … מַכְשֶׁרֶת is it the blood (as a liquid) which fits the meat for uncleanness?; is it not rather the slaughtering (because it makes it ‘an eatable’)?—Ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> חיבת הקדש מַכְשַׁרְתָּן, v. חִבָּה; ib. 36
<sup>b</sup> מַכְשַׁרְתָּהּ. Makhsh. VI, 6. Y. Gitt. I, 43
<sup>c</sup> על מי בצים שאינן מַכְשִׁירִין that the liquid of eggs does not fit for uncleanness; Y. Shebi. VI, 36
<sup>c</sup> top שאין כשירין (corr. acc.); a. v. fr.—V. הֶכְשֵׁר, מַכְשִׁירִין.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>a</sup> כל שאינו כשר … וה' לזה וכ' that which is not fit for preservation but appeared fit to this man, and he did preserve it. Ḥull. 22
